description: This file defines various API request functions for a web application, including GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE operations, as well as functions to manage work items and comments. It handles authentication headers, error processing, and interacts with localStorage to retrieve user info.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines whether a given API path is public or requires authentication.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Constructs request headers, adding Authorization when necessary.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles non-OK HTTP responses, manages auth clearance on 401, and throws errors.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs HTTP DELETE requests with automatic auth headers and error handling.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST requests with JSON payload, auth headers, and error handling.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs HTTP GET requests with optional query params, handles JSON parsing and errors.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Performs HTTP PATCH requests with JSON payload, auth headers, and error handling.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item by project ID and item ID.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with optional metadata, setting creator info from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Generates full URL for an API path based on current base URL.
